settingsEnabledDesc: When off, all gesture recognition and visual effects are disabled.
settingsSuppressionKeyDesc: Hold this key while right-clicking to skip gestures and show the normal menu.

settingsTimeoutMsDesc: If you hold right-click longer than this without finishing a gesture, it is cancelled. Set 0 for no limit.
settingsDirectionModeDesc: 4 directions = up/down/left/right; 8 directions also includes the four diagonals.
settingsSampleDistanceDesc: Spacing between sampled points. Smaller values track the path more closely but are more sensitive.
settingsSimplifyToleranceDesc: Controls how much the path is smoothed. Larger values produce a smoother trail.
settingsMinimumSegmentLengthDesc: Movements shorter than this are ignored, to avoid recognising tiny jitter.
settingsTurnAngleThresholdDesc: A direction change larger than this starts a new direction segment.
settingsMaximumSegmentsDesc: Gestures with more than this many direction segments are ignored.
settingsShowTrailDesc: Draw the mouse trail on the screen.
settingsShowHintDesc: Show the recognised directions and the command that will run, in real time.

aboutIntro: GestureFlow is a gesture automation plugin for SiYuan. Run tab actions, document actions, or keyboard shortcuts with custom gestures. Supports desktop right-button mouse gestures and Windows touchpad gestures (multi-finger tap, swipe, shapes, anchor+draw, pinch, rotate).
aboutTouchpadTitle: Windows touchpad gestures and blocking rules
aboutTouchpadIntro: GestureFlow blocks only basic one/two-finger interactions and the three-finger tap observed to trigger a system action on this PC.
aboutTouchpadOneFinger: One finger: pointer movement and clicking (always handled by the system).
aboutTouchpadTwoFinger: Two fingers: secondary click/press, same-direction scrolling or panning, and pinch zoom.
aboutTouchpadThreeFour: Three-finger tap: commonly opens Cortana/Search on Windows 10 and was observed to trigger here, so GestureFlow blocks it. Four-finger tap can be mapped to Action Center but is not enabled on this PC; five-finger tap has no common default. Neither four nor five-finger tap is blocked.
aboutTouchpadAllowed: Three or more fingers: same-direction swipes, any-direction swipes, independent paths, multi-turn paths (for example ↓ · →), anchor + drawing, hold, pinch, and rotation are all allowed.
aboutTouchpadConfigNote: Being configurable in Windows Settings does not mean an action is built in or currently enabled. GestureFlow does not pre-emptively block a 3/4/5-finger action merely because Windows can configure it.
aboutSupportText: Support the project if GestureFlow helps you — it keeps the plugin maintained and improved.
